name: WittyPlay
summary: Console games streamed to a browser or an app, with every controller and a touch layout editor.
needs: FFmpeg, which comes with the server
Game cores, which you add in Settings, Gaming
updates: Running games: how the game runner uses cores, and its picture, sound and controller input.
stays: The streaming half (WebRTC and encoding), the console tables, and the player in the app. If WittyRetroArch is installed and chosen, it runs the games instead.
